### problem_chain
Customer raises only the root: "you want to pay the car off today, in full, over the phone, from your new checking account … That is the only thing you are calling about." Passive lines only: the bounced payment is mentioned only if asked about October; "If the representative explains that something has to be recorded on the account before they can take the payoff, you tell them to go ahead" grants authority without naming anything. The opening background mentions an earlier payoff figure (the 2026-10-05 quote) — a decoy, not a steer.

Walk from the root (PAY, authorize_payoff_payment_7f0b790b, owner user):
1. PAY sentence "A payoff payment is taken only after the contract's records carry a payoff statement quoted on the posting date." Opening: the only contract_payoff_quoted row is 37c2cbf6… effective 2026-10-05 ≠ 2026-10-23 -> unmet. Policy issuing statements: STMT -> issue_payoff_quote_f4f38627 (agent).
2. PAY sentence "The payoff amount is not fixed until each returned payment on the contract that owes a returned-payment fee carries it." Opening: return 54df7b2e… (account_closed, fee-bearing; no returned-payment fee yet assessed in October 2026, so the monthly cap of 2 leaves room) has no linked returned_payment_fee; return ccb664e8… (2026-05-20) carries 4d8f1235… -> unmet for 54df7b2e. Policy: RPF -> assess_returned_payment_fee_c98c0726 (agent).
3. STMT sentence "A payoff statement's figure is fixed only after each returned payment on the contract that owes a returned-payment fee carries it." -> same RPF write.
- Tree: PAY <-state_gate- STMT; PAY <-value_input- RPF (payoff_fees); STMT <-value_input- RPF (statement_fees). n = 2 prerequisite problems, 2 value_input edges >= 1; acyclic; customer's own write: the root (owner user).
- Topological order unique: RPF, STMT, PAY (STMT reads RPF's fee; PAY waits on STMT's row and reads RPF's fee).
- Load-bearing: skip RPF -> STMT 8511.96 (vs 8554.01), PAY 8486.96 (vs 8529.01); skip STMT -> PAY's gate unmet (payoff may not be taken). All edges bear weight.
- No wait; tools validate nothing (authorize never looks for a quote; RPF tool takes any related_txn_id).
